internal.title: Incident Summary: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 12:20 UTC on 2026-11-08, a high latency alert was triggered for the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion, specifically high CPU utilization, as the root cause. This was correlated with the recent enabling of the 'adHighCpu' flag. No errors or memory leaks were detected, and traces showed slow responses without errors. The mitigation involved disabling the 'adHighCpu' flag at 12:40 UTC, which led to verified recovery with latency metrics returning to normal levels. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 12:20:21: Alert received for high latency
- 12:40:12: Diagnosis confirmed CPU resource exhaustion
- 12:40:18: Disabled 'adHighCpu' flag
- 12:40:18: Recovery verified with normalized latency

Action Taken:
- Disabled the 'adHighCpu' flag to reduce CPU load

Lessons Learned:
- Monitor CPU utilization flags closely as they can directly impact service latency.
- Rapid flag toggling can be an effective mitigation for resource exhaustion issues.

Severity: SEV2

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 12:20 and 12:40 UTC on November 8, 2026, the ad service experienced elevated latency. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting system settings to reduce CPU load. Service performance has returned to normal, and no further impact is expected. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
